text:
elaine: Hey support — customer ACME (org: org-42) says their audit history is missing older events. They expect 365d retention but UI and API only return ~90 days. Can someone take a look?
ops-bot: Thanks @elaine — I've created ticket #SUP-8132 and assigned to infra team.
raj: Can you paste minimal repro steps and a sample API call/response? Also are they on Hosted or Dedicated?
elaine: Hosted. Steps: open org settings -> Compliance -> Audit logs -> set date range older than 90d. UI shows empty list.
elaine: API repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org-42/audit_logs?start=2024-01-01&end=2024-06-01"
```
Response: HTTP 403
```json
{"error":"audit_logs_access_denied","reason":"retention_entitlement_missing","message":"No read entitlement for audit_logs with requested retention"}
```
ingrid: Hmm — "retention_entitlement_missing" typically means the org doesn't have the longer retention flag. Do they show entitlement in the org admin panel?
elaine: In customer console it shows "Audit logs retention: 365d" for the org.
raj: Two quick checks: 1) confirm org.entitlements from internal API, 2) check SSO/SCIM claim mapping for compliance groups. Can you run the internal diagnostic and paste results?
elaine: I ran:
```bash
GET /internal/orgs/org-42/entitlements
```
Result: `{"audit_log_retention_days":"365","audit_logs_read":false}`
elaine: So retention days = 365 but read flag is false. That looks wrong.
raj: OK that explains it — retention meta set but read entitlement false -> API forbids access. Likely a migration bug when we rolled out retention entitlements last quarter.
ops-lead: If audit_logs_read is false, customer should be able to get a temporary grant via admin console. As workaround we can flip the read flag for org-42 while we patch.
ingrid: I remember a migration edge-case where legacy orgs created before the new compliance schema didn't get the default `audit_logs_read` set when retention>90.
elaine: Customer is blocked for compliance requests — they asked for a timeline.
raj: I'll escalate to infra with repro and the ticket. Quick mitigation steps for support: run internal admin call to set read entitlement. Example (internal only):
```bash
POST /internal/admin/orgs/org-42/entitlements
Content-Type: application/json
{ "audit_log_retention_days": 365, "audit_logs_read": true }
```
raj: After that verify API returns events for older ranges.
elaine: Doing that now and will update ACME.
elaine: (after admin change) Verified — API now returns events back to 2024-01-01. Customer confirmed. :tada:
ops-lead: Good. We should add a migration job to backfill `audit_logs_read` for all legacy orgs where retention>90. Filed task INF-4217.
ingrid: I'll add a product note to avoid surprising customers.
raj: Marking ticket SUP-8132 as fixed with mitigation; follow-up: permanent patch + backfill.
elaine: Thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Ticket SUP-8132 status -> resolved (temporary entitlement applied).
_metadata_note: Document created to capture a support thread about audit log read entitlement mismatch for retention settings. Internal endpoints and admin actions are example placeholders for internal debugging only.
